name: STANLEY STMT81243 Mechanics Multi-Tool Set (110 Pieces)
shortDescription: Professional 110-piece mechanical service toolkit with 1/4" and 1/2" quick-release ratchets, metric sockets, extension bars, and combination spanners.
overview: The STANLEY STMT81243 is a premier 110-piece master mechanic's socket and wrench set engineered for industrial machinery technicians, automotive workshops, and maintenance squads. Forged from high-grade Chrome Vanadium steel with a durable satin chrome micro-finish, this set features both 1/4-inch and 1/2-inch drive 72-tooth pear-head ratchets providing a tight 5-degree swing arc for working in cramped spaces. The kit includes an exhaustive array of 6-point Maxi-Drive sockets, deep sockets, spark plug sockets, combination wrenches, hex keys, extension bars, and Torx/Hex driver bits.
